title: GO Command Center CURRENT_CONTROL_STATE
description: Deterministic projection of the GitHub-native Control Plane. Scope: CONTROL_STATE_AND_STATUS_ONLY. Derived, rebuildable and NON-AUTHORITATIVE. Every leaf is an assertion ranked PROVEN / OBSERVED / PENDING / HOLD / FAILED / UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN always carries value=null and never implies success. Deploy readiness and rollback readiness are NOT evaluated: recorded release-gate and rollback-candidate facts live under control_state.informational with contract=false. The document carries no workstation path, no temp directory and no local absolute path: sources are identified by repository, ref, commit SHA and repository-relative path only. request_visibility reports what the Command Center Bridge did with each Request, from facts exported read-only; a Request is never reported as accepted unless a signed Task on the control bus corroborates it.
x-go-request-facts: A Request file on the control bus means a human wrote it. It never means the Request was accepted.
REQUEST_VALIDATED requires all three: the named Task is on the control bus, its task_id carries sha256(request_id)[:12], and its signature verifies against the published Command Center task identity.
A fact is an observation of the Bridge. It authorizes no retry, no replay and no action, and the projection refuses any fact that claims otherwise.
A duplicate or a replay is reported as its own lifecycle and is never counted as a success.

liveness_window_seconds.description: age <= this -> PROVEN; age > this -> UNKNOWN, never PROVEN.

liveness_transport_grace_seconds.description: Delivery slack between the probe interval and the freshness window.

sources.description: Portable provenance: repository, ref, commit SHA and repository-relative pointer path only.

proven_allowed.description: true only when both verifier identities are BOUND and the two roles resolve to different keys

fail_closed_reasons.description: for example 'task:IDENTITY_MISMATCH'; empty means nothing failed closed

x-go-binding-rules: BOUND means the supplied key's SSH SHA256 fingerprint equals the fingerprint published in the identity contract.
MISSING_KEY, KEY_UNREADABLE, IDENTITY_MISMATCH, IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED and IDENTITY_COLLISION are all fail-closed and may never yield PROVEN.
A key that merely loads is not the right key, so 'the signature verified' is never by itself an identity claim.

requests.description: One entry per collected Request file, plus one per Bridge fact whose Request file was not collected. lifecycle is the strongest fact that could actually be proven.

lifecycle.description: UNKNOWN means the Bridge spoke about this Request but its file is not on the control bus. REQUEST_VALIDATED is reported only when a signed Task corroborates the acceptance.

reason_code.description: the refusing component's own token, preserved verbatim

facts.description: Every fact for this Request, including ones that could not be proven. An ineffective fact is reported, never hidden.

request_visibility.description: CC V1-05. What happened to the Requests, from the Bridge's own exported facts. Bounded, non-authoritative, and never a verdict.

duplicate_or_replay.description: Each entry records counted_as_success = false. A duplicate or a replay is never a success.

bridge_fact_export_installed.description: the exporter exists and is verified in CI, but nothing drives it or publishes to the control bus yet

enabled_request_actions.description: Everything the channel may currently create, human and platform together.

human_request_actions.description: Actions a human / ChatGPT Request channel may express. HK_STAGING_DEPLOY belongs here and remains gated by deployment_requests_enabled, the approved plan and the approval.

platform_request_actions.description: Actions the platform's own bounded producer creates. Being listed here is never a human execution right.

platform_action_properties.description: What a platform action is allowed to be: fixed empty parameters, read_only, human_deploy_authority false. Constants, never derived from a Request.

known_capabilities.description: Everything the Control Plane can execute, whether or not it is requestable.

hk_agent_last_activity.description: Newest signed CONTROL_PLANE_HEALTH Evidence at any age. Activity is NOT liveness.

deploy_capability.description: Capability classification only: CAPABILITY_PRESENT_BUT_DISABLED with request_enabled=false and readiness_evaluation=NOT_IN_SCOPE. Never a readiness verdict.

repository_runtime_pointer.description: What the repository DECLARES. Never the truth about what is running on Hong Kong, so never PROVEN.

live_verified_runtime.description: The image named by the newest VERIFY Evidence. PROVEN only when that Evidence's signature verified.

repository_main_sha.description: UNKNOWN unless supplied explicitly. Never substituted by a runtime source SHA.

stuck_answer.description: Answers 'is anything stuck right now' from active_stuck_tasks only.

active_tasks.description: Published, still inside the validity window.

active_stuck_tasks.description: Published, still inside the validity window, older than stuck_after_seconds with no Evidence.

deploy_readiness.description: CC V1-06. The verdict the separate read-only evaluator produced, quoted verbatim: value is YES / NO, or the state is UNKNOWN when it could not be established. Never evaluated here, and YES is never an approval.

deploy_readiness_gates.description: One entry per gate the evaluator reported, in its own order. Empty when no verdict was supplied. A gate that is not PASS is present here, never omitted.

informational.description: Non-contract recorded facts. contract=false. Deploy and rollback readiness are NOT evaluated.

deploy_readiness_evaluation.description: EVALUATED_READ_ONLY once a verdict from control-plane/command-center-deploy-readiness-v1 is carried. Even then this projection evaluates nothing itself and a YES authorises nothing.

deploy_readiness_document.description: repository-relative path of the verdict document, or null when none was supplied; never a workstation path

ssh_sha256_fingerprint.description: sha256 over the ssh wire blob, as ssh-keygen and the archived audit files report it

expected_ssh_sha256_fingerprint.description: the fingerprint pinned by the identity contract

path.description: repository-relative when the published contract is used, otherwise a fixed marker; never a workstation path

x-go-rank-rules: PROVEN requires the artifact's own verifier identity to verify: a Task against the Command Center task key, Evidence against the Hong Kong evidence key, and COMPLETE requires both.
PROVEN additionally requires both identities to be BOUND to the published VERIFIER_IDENTITIES_V1 contract. An unbound, mismatched, unreadable, missing or colliding key caps the claim at OBSERVED.
OBSERVED means a published record was read but its signature was not checked, or the claim is a pointer rather than a live proof.
PENDING is reserved for an in-flight lifecycle stage still inside its bound.
HOLD means an explicit policy or release gate blocks the claim.
FAILED requires a terminal, evidence-backed failure record.
UNKNOWN means the control bus cannot answer; speculation is forbidden.
